input: Get an allergy panel test done this month

gold.taskTitle: Get an Allergy Panel Test Done This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and complete an allergy panel test within the current month.

questions.title: Do you have a doctor's referral for this test?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has a referral or needs to get one first.

questions.title: Have you been tested for allergies before?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a first-time test or a follow-up, which affects the process.

questions.title: Which specific allergens do you want tested?
questions.description: Determine the scope of the panel — food, environmental, skin, or a comprehensive panel.

questions.title: Do you have health insurance that covers allergy testing?
questions.description: Clarify insurance status to determine cost, coverage, and provider network constraints.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred clinic, lab, or specialist?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a go-to provider or needs help identifying one.

questions.title: What symptoms or concerns are driving this test?
questions.description: Understand the underlying reason — this may influence which type of test is most appropriate.

questions.title: By what date this month must the test be completed?
questions.description: Pin down any hard deadline within the month to prioritize scheduling urgency.
